fidelity: The laptop tier is a lower-fidelity approximation of nf-core/riboseq: reads were subsampled, aligned with bowtie2 to one GENCODE transcript per gene (no genome alignment, no splice-aware mapping, no multi-isoform handling), and P-site offsets came from a simple mode rule rather than riboWaltz or a trained model.
psite_rule: 5′-end offset per read length 25–35 nt = mode of the distance to the start codon (the most abundant length's offset when fewer than 200 reads or more than 3 nt away from it), then corrected to the nearest value that puts the dominant in-CDS frame of that length in frame 0 (riboWaltz-style); CDS counts exclude the first 15 and last 5 codons; MAPQ ≥ 10

warnings: The laptop tier is a lower-fidelity approximation of nf-core/riboseq: reads were subsampled, aligned with bowtie2 to one GENCODE transcript per gene (no genome alignment, no splice-aware mapping, no multi-isoform handling), and P-site offsets came from a simple mode rule rather than riboWaltz or a trained model.
'genotype/variation' takes 2 values among the chosen libraries (sgLARP1, wild-type); the contrast pools them.

4 libraries (GSM3889081, GSM3889082, GSM3889083, GSM3889084) had more than half of their reads match neither rRNA nor a protein-coding transcript; such reads are usually other non-coding RNA (tRNA, snoRNA) that the one-transcript-per-gene reference does not hold, so the counts rest on the smaller mRNA fraction.
